Alger, 7 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 7, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The operator Djezzy took part on Thursday, November 5, in the launch of the AST Festival hosted at the École Nationale Supérieure des Technologies des Systèmes Autonomes located in Sidi Abdellah. This event dedicated to engineering and autonomous systems runs from November five to eight with the support of the institution and the AST Club.
Le pôle scientifique de Sidi Abdellah ab: The Sidi Abdellah scientific hub hosts the robotics festival
L'École Nationale Supérieure des Technol: The École Nationale Supérieure des Technologies des Systèmes Autonomes, established within the Sidi Abdellah scientific and technological hub, is hosting the competition organized jointly with the Autonomous Systems Technologies Club. The kick-off of this event was given on Thursday, November 5, 2026, in the presence of representatives from the company and the higher education institution.
Pendant toute la durée de l'événement, q: Throughout the event, which spans from November five to eight, the gathering highlights engineering, programming, as well as robotics and innovation. The competition brings together students from diverse academic backgrounds, offering them an exhibition space and fourteen different contests to design, develop, and showcase their projects.
La fin de cette édition est fixée au dim: The end of this edition is set for Sunday, November 8, when the award ceremony will take place to honor the winners of the various events. Through its support for this initiative, Djezzy aims to back the national digital and technological ecosystem and encourage the emergence of new future skills. This partnership also aims to build bridges between the academic world and the professional sector by sharing expertise and highlighting the potential of Algerian youth.
